cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Test the Story First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to repeat the explanation, ask the dangerous question, or test the risky step before you commit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Ask Dad why our holiday account's empty. I'll wait by the kitchen door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Come with me. You booked the flights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Ask whether he's angry about the price first. If he isn't, I'll come in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask, but I'm calling you in if he wants the flight receipt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask whether he wants the total or the breakdown before you call me. The seat upgrades need a longer explanation.

mechanism: A commands a family intermediary to probe anger and documentary scrutiny before A enters the conversation.
confusable: Unlike asking for help with a discussion, A repeatedly conditions joining on B testing the danger first.
comparison: Holiday-account spending and upgrade receipt differ from a committee's unsigned financial explanation.
seedUse: The seed already controls entry and assigns increasingly narrow probes, merging S01 rank with D128 risk avoidance.
